hymns.title: Thine Is the Glory
hymns.first_line: Thine is the glory, risen, conqu'ring Son
hymns.author: Edmond L. Budry, 1854-1932; translated by Richard B. Hoyle, 1875-1939

hymn_sections.lyrics:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Save from wrath and make me pure.

Amazing grace! how sweet the sound,
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found,
Was blind, but now I see.

'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

These words are still under copyright,
So the app shares only the title.

How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His excellent Word!
What more can He say than to you He hath said,
To you who for refuge to Jesus have fled?

Fear not, I am with thee, O be not dismayed,
For I am thy God, I will still give thee aid;
I'll strengthen thee, help thee, and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by My gracious, omnipotent hand.

Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour all the day long.

Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

Thine is the glory, risen, conqu'ring Son;
Endless is the vict'ry Thou o'er death hast won.

Thine is the glory, risen, conqu'ring Son;
Endless is the vict'ry Thou o'er death hast won.

Lo! Jesus meets us, risen from the tomb;
Lovingly He greets us, scatters fear and gloom.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

reading_parts.speaker: people
reading_parts.body: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

reading_parts.speaker: all
reading_parts.body: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: the Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.

reading_parts.speaker: leader
reading_parts.body: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

reading_parts.speaker: all
reading_parts.body: I believe in God the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth:

reading_parts.speaker: all
reading_parts.body: And in Jesus Christ his only Son our Lord.

reading_parts.speaker: all
reading_parts.body: Having been led, as we believe, by the Spirit of God, we do now most solemnly and joyfully enter into **covenant** with one another.

reading_parts.speaker: all
